subject.title: UI Update button breaks Gateway when npm global + launchd (handoff deadlock)

question: For a managed npm-global LaunchAgent Gateway, should an update with no version change return before restart, refuse UI-managed execution with a clear recovery action, or retain a durable handoff that reports final service health?
rationale: The reports establish real failure modes, but choosing between no-op short-circuiting, explicit refusal, and durable recovery changes the public update and operator-recovery contract.

options.title: Short-circuit proven no-op updates
options.body: Return without stopping the Gateway only when package resolution proves the installed version will not change, while preserving handoff for real upgrades.

options.title: Refuse managed UI handoff
options.body: Return an explicit unsupported or recovery-required result for this install/service shape instead of attempting a potentially unsafe handoff.

options.title: Strengthen durable handoff
options.body: Keep managed handoff but require launchd bootstrap recovery and final health confirmation before reporting success.

recommendation.title: Short-circuit proven no-op updates
recommendation.body: Return without stopping the Gateway only when package resolution proves the installed version will not change, while preserving handoff for real upgrades.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and previously framed the exact pending product/restart-contract decision.
